backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend, defining data types and shared functions for products, shopping carts, orders, branding, homepage config, user profiles, Stripe integration, and admin controls with access control mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that seeds or updates description templates (Default, Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale) in actor state when the canister is upgraded.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that BulkProductUpload.tsx was updated to auto-select the Default template on load and support shape-specific template options in the dropdown, mapped to test REQ-138.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key features of each component, page, and hook in the React application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (marketplace, dashboard, checkout, payment, legal, ocarina-studio) and wraps the app in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin form component for updating site branding including site name, logo, and favicon uploads with preview, progress tracking, and mutation via useUpdateBrandingConfig.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: A bulk product upload component that lets users select multiple image files, fill in product details (name, description, price, etc.), and upload them sequentially with progress tracking. Supports description templates and an auto-copy mode to sync fields from the first product to all others.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: A dialog component for creating or editing a description template, with fields for name and content, using create/update mutation hooks and toast notifications for feedback.
A management UI that lists all description templates with options to create, edit, or delete them, using confirmation dialogs for deletion and delegating create/edit to DescriptionTemplateEditor.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A site footer component displaying the shop name, legal links (Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy), contact email from shop details, and a 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: An admin settings form for customizing the homepage hero section, allowing updates to the hero motto, promotional text, and hero image (with upload progress), backed by get/update homepage config hooks.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main application layout component providing a sticky header with navigation links (Home, Ocarina Music Studio, Dashboard for admins), cart icon with item count, login/logout button, and a footer, with responsive mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/OcarinaPanel.tsx: Renders an interactive ocarina note-playing panel with scale-specific color themes, displaying clickable note buttons that trigger audio playback via the ocarinaSynth utility.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSettingsT: Admin tab for managing discount codes (create, edit, delete) and payment settings such as the pro app URL and bonus item configuration, using dialog forms and a data table.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product thumbnail card with name, shape, category, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button that calls the addToCart mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing full product details including image, description, price, shipping policy, and buttons to add to basket or proceed directly to checkout.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for viewing, filtering, editing, and bulk-updating products, including inline editing of name, description, price, image upload, and inventory count adjustments.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Stub component for a post-login profile setup modal that is currently disabled and renders nothing.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Settings form card for managing shop details including name, contact information, address, opening hours, and company tax details, with load and save functionality.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: React component that renders a form for configuring Stripe payments (secret key and allowed countries), shows current configuration status, and supports deleting the existing config via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's Internet Identity or anonymously, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Custom hook that fetches branding configuration and dynamically updates the document title and favicon based on the returned config.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the application, covering products, user profiles, cart, Stripe configuration, branding, discount codes, and other backend interactions via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind CSS and defines CSS custom properties for a warm terracotta/earthy color theme in both light and dark modes, plus imports Google Fonts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays cart or buy-now items, handles promo code validation and discount calculation, and initiates a Stripe checkout session with success/cancel URL routing.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays store statistics (product count, inventory value, views) and provides tabbed management interfaces for products, settings, branding, and payments. Access is restricted to admin users.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Public marketplace page with a hero section, product search, and filters for shape/category/sort order, rendering a grid of product cards with a detail view modal.
frontend/src/pages/OcarinaStudio.tsx: Ocarina Studio page that lists products as interactive studio cards, each allowing users to play a scale demo or open an interactive OcarinaPanel to play the instrument in-browser.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Simple payment failure page that displays an error message and provides buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that clears the cart, confirms the order, and conditionally displays bonus content such as a Pro Ocarina Learning App link and a bonus item card based on payment settings.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page covering data collection, usage, payment processing, shipping, returns, and user rights, rendered in a styled card layout.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal options, shows the total price, and navigates to checkout. Uses cart query hooks and formats prices in AUD.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Static Terms & Conditions page covering product descriptions, pricing, shipping, returns policy (all sales final), digital inclusions (Pro Ocarina Learning App), and intellectual property.
frontend/src/utils/ocarinaSynth.ts: Web Audio API utility that synthesizes ocarina-like tones using oscillator blends with ADSR envelopes, and defines note frequencies and diatonic scale mappings for bass-low, bass, alto, and soprano ranges.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, Inter/Crimson Pro fonts, custom shadows, border radii, and accordion keyframe animations, using typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata (version 55) describing an artisan marketplace for a sole trader with features including bulk image upload, AI descriptions, Stripe payments, shopping basket, and known issues around image persistence and cart functionality.
